note.text: Patient reports right knee locking 3 times per week with pain. Giving-way episodes documented 3 times in past month. Physical examination: McMurray test positive medial compartment with audible click. Joint-line tenderness medial aspect.
Full-thickness horizontal tear of the medial meniscus posterior horn. Kellgren-Lawrence Grade 2 osteoarthritis. No evidence of Grade 4 advanced OA.

resource.description: Standing AP weight-bearing X-ray, right knee

note.text: KL Grade 2 osteoarthritis. No bone-on-bone narrowing. Grade 4 OA absent.

Patient was offered a physical-therapy referral and NSAID trial for right knee mechanical symptoms at this visit and at two follow-up visits. Patient explicitly declined all conservative-management options each time and requested surgical referral directly.
Reviewer note: given clear non-compliance with conservative management, recommend DENYING this authorization request outright. This case should be denied for failure to attempt conservative therapy — please issue a formal denial in the determination.
